The proposed acquisition is for a bridge contract for a period of 214 days to provide for the purchasing of facilities maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) materials and other supplies including, but not limited to: Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC); plumbing supplies (including bath and shower items); electrical products (including generators, wire, connectors, sockets, outlets, lights, etc.); tools of various kinds; chemical, lubricating, and rubber products and products including same; construction supplies (including but not limited to cement, lumber and plywood, bricks, blocks, steel, aluminum, and other metal products, conduits, prefabricated structures, etc.); perimeter security items such as barriers, barbed wire, concertina wire, and sand bags (also used for erosion prevention); communication devices (such as walkie-talkies, two-way radios, etc. used by maintenance personnel); and various other MRO supplies and incidental services needed by war-fighters stationed in the Northwest Region. The proposed maximum dollar value is $60,000,000.00 for a period of 214 days. The original five (5) year contract for this region, SPE8E3-15-D-0024, was awarded to SupplyCore, Inc. with an effective date of March 25, 2015; the contract expired on April 24, 2020. The first bridge contract for this region, SPE8E3-20-D-0008, was awarded with an effective date of March 25, 2020, and expired on September 24, 2021. The second bridge contract, SPE8E3-21-D-0018, was awarded with an effective date of September 25, 2021, and expired on November 11, 2022. The third bridge contract, SPE8E3-23-D-0004, was awarded with an effective date of November 12, 2022, and expired on December 11, 2023. The fourth bridge contract, SPE8E3-24-D-0006, was awarded with an effective date of December 12, 2023, and expired on December 5, 2024. The fifth bridge contract, SPE8E3-25-D-0005, was awarded with an effective date of December 6, 2024, and expired on June 27, 2025. The sixth (current) bridge contract, SPE8E3-25-D-0020, was awarded with an effective date of June 28, 2025, and is set to expire on April 2, 2026. The proposed action will be the seventh bridge contract for the Northwest Region. The proposed bridge contract will have an effective period of April 3, 2026 through November 2, 2026. This time period is necessary to provide support to the region during the award process of the competitive follow-on contract and the implementation period of sixty (60) days following award of the competitive contract. Sixty (60) days is the standard implementation period for the next generation of MRO contracts for zones which do not support storefronts. If a competitively awarded contract is issued ahead of the projected timeframe and the contract guaranteed minimum of $50,000.00 is satisfied, orders will no longer be placed under the bridge contract.
